title: Lenovo Idea Tab 128GB 8GB RAM $299 Delivered @ Lenovo Outlet
body:
Deal: Lenovo Idea Tab 128GB 8GB RAM $299 Delivered @ Lenovo Outlet

[dosada] They have ads running that all outlet items will be 60% off of RRP for black Friday
[jughead101] I will keep the receipt to return or price match :)
[RichardF89] there is no free return from Lenovo. I think they charge 10% of the final price plus shipping.
[jughead101] Thanks @RichardF89 .. its 20% not even 10% …
[Azif] Hasnt this been to 200 with cashback before
[boozed] I like that it's specified that the RAM is soldered, as if any mainstream Android tablet uses DIMMs
[Snoots] Good price for 8GB.
More doom and gloom on the memory front:
https://www.theregister.com/systems/2026/10/28/sk-hynix-says…
Bloody depressing
[CodeXD] 256gb/8gb was down to $299 before. I think might come back again for black friday
[hollykryten] And yet TGG never got stock back in. That was a sign they were dumping the stock. It might be a discontinued model.
